def tab2sp(line, spaces):
    """ convert an indent of tab to spaces 
    ex.) python main.py -tab2sp 4
        --> an indenct of tab to 4 spaces
    """
    cnt = 0
    tabs = "\t"
    while line.startswith(tabs):
        cnt += 1
        tabs += "\t"
    return line.replace("\t", spaces, cnt)
